summary: Callan JMB Inc. and its subsidiary Callan Power LLC entered an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire Reger Oil, Inc.'s oil and gas assets in the Williston Basin. Consideration: $10M in Series A Perpetual Convertible Preferred Stock (1,000 shares) plus $2M cash, payable by Dec 31, 2026. Closing expected by Sep 22, 2026, subject to conditions including stockholder approval per Nasdaq rules, diligence, and no litigation. Governance changes include renaming Buyer to Reger Energy, appointing Michael Reger as President and director, and board seat adjustments. Watch for regulatory approvals and stockholder vote timing.
